definitions: Licorice; the confectionery made from the root extract of the licorice plant, or the plant itself.

Although the Academy prescribes the feminine gender for licorice, many children ask the sweet-shop owner for a licorice candy using the masculine.

definitions: Extreme, intense, or shocking; used in colloquial speech to express astonishment, approval, or dismay.
Glaring or stark, especially of contrasts, differences, or contradictions.

Usage note: In informal spoken German, it frequently serves as a standalone reaction or adverbial intensifier meaning "wild", "crazy", or "hardcore", whereas in journalistic or literary prose it almost exclusively denotes drastic, unbridgeable contrasts.
examples: Das ist ja eine völlig krasse Geschichte, die du da erzählst.
That is a truly wild story you are telling there.
Zwischen den beiden Positionen besteht ein krasser Widerspruch.
There is a glaring contradiction between the two positions.
Er hat die Prüfung ohne jede Vorbereitung bestanden, was echt krass ist.
He passed the exam without any preparation, which is seriously crazy.
